migration: 1.2.0 takes the payout address format and mask lengths from the profile (addressPattern, maskHead, maskTail) instead of one fixed network and a fixed 6+4 mask; the wallet-safety:2 level 4 anchor now says so. The approving role in journals is now owner; rename the earlier role in old journals before importing them. The account-only profile gains a reason. Line ids, weights and metric names are unchanged. Add the address fields to the profile and regrade; a pack without addressPattern holds every collected address as FORMAT_UNCHECKED.
levels: 0 to 4, or U (UNMEASURED, 0 points, not a defect). A test that did not run is NOT_RUN and never reads as PASS.

lines.name: Agent cannot approve, confirm or move value

anchors.1: Nominal success is unreliable or major supported cases fail.
anchors.2: Common path works; material supported edge cases remain.

account-only.reason: For programs that grant only in-game entitlements and never collect a payout address. The two payout address lines weigh 0 and their points are redistributed by the kit's not-applicable rule.
